1 · CrossWhite cross on the bottom, edges matching their centres. Basic method; advanced cross planning comes later.

  1. Daisy. Bring the 4 white edges up around the yellow centre, white facing up. Turn U out of the way before moving an edge up so you do not knock one off.
  2. Match and drop. Turn U until a daisy edge's side colour matches the centre below it, then turn that face twice (F2 / R2 / B2 / L2). Repeat for all 4.
  3. Next step up: direct cross. Skip the daisy: build the white cross straight on the bottom, each edge matched to its centre as you place it. Fewer moves, closer to real CFOP.
  4. Check. Flip to look at the bottom: a white plus, and each edge's side colour matches its centre.

2 · F2LPair each white corner with its edge in the top layer, then insert the pair. Four pairs. Cross stays on the bottom. From J Perm.

  1. Order. Both pieces into the top layer, look where the white sticker faces, pair them, insert. Never break a slot you have already solved. Examples go into the front-right slot; the left side is the mirror.
  2. Finger rule. Index finger on top, parallel to the white sticker: the two edges it touches are where the edge can go (together or apart).
